summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of NordicForge business management platform. Backend APIs working excellently (96% success rate). Frontend authentication, navigation, and core UI components working correctly. Minor invoice creation status code issue identified.

minor_issues.issue: Returns status 200 instead of expected 201 for successful creation
minor_issues.impact: Invoice creation works correctly, but returns wrong HTTP status code
